feedback.end: Fire salamanders can be identified by their bright black and yellow skin, which warns predators that they can be poisonous. Fire salamanders can also take in oxygen through their skin, as it is not a solid barrier like ours!
If a fire salamander loses its tail in a fight, it can just grow another one. They are also able to regrow more complicated body parts, like arms, legs or even organs!
Fire salamanders mainly eat insects, worms and other small critters. They may even eat their own tadpoles!
